## Design

### 2026-10-19 – October 19th: Idea set

**2h**

October 19th: Idea set

Instruments. Instruments are nice to listen and most like guitar and piano do one thing. Playing chords. Playing chords is essential when trying to play a piece or sing along to a song. This is why I designed Chordial.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/01a7bbb25f6bd9d968b7a25174c6de5ae101dcbc04fcce18e29e7c8ae7186274.png)

Electronics used
XIAO ESP32-C3
MAX98357A  amplifier
speaker
SSD1306 OLED
EC11 rotary encoder
 2 momentary push buttons

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/33044b92b121dfd68399054f50f687416b1ead370d97811ef48f280a9535f27c.png)
Then set up github repository. Then made the Kicad File. Ready to work tomorrow.

### 2026-10-20 – October 20th: PCB

**3h**

October 20th: PCB

Today I started my day finding all the parts that I needed and looked up how to use them in KiCAD

I decided to use the Seedstudio Xiao ESP32-S3  because it has a bit more pins than ESP32-C3.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/dd3600f5c40797e394ebf6c179c26b24f46879f741ae9263d42d4e5c6c880905.png)
